title: GP Receptionist & Administrator
description: Join Our Team at Shah Zaman Surgery We are looking for a motivated, professional, and patient-focused GP Receptionist & Administrator to join our friendly and supportive team for 29 hours per week across 4 days. This is an excellent opportunity to become part of a busy, forward-thinking GP practice where you will play a key role in delivering outstanding service to our patients and supporting the smooth day-to-day running of the surgery. As the first point of contact for patients, you will provide a welcoming and efficient service, managing appointments, handling patient enquiries, undertaking recall activities to support QOF and contractual targets, and carrying out a range of administrative duties. You will work closely with our multidisciplinary team and liaise with external healthcare providers to ensure patients receive timely access to the care and services they need. We are proud of our collaborative and supportive working environment and are committed to providing high-quality patient care. In return, we offer 30 days annual leave plus bank holidays (pro rata), access to the NHS Pension Scheme, and opportunities to develop your skills within primary care.Please note that the working pattern may include one late evening per week, finishing at 8:00pm. Flexibility is essential, as additional hours and changes to working days may occasionally be required to provide cover for annual leave, sickness absence, training, and the operational needs of the practice. We are looking for a proactive and organised GP Receptionist & Administrator to join our friendly practice team. The successful candidate will provide a professional front-line service to patients, managing appointments, answering telephone and face-to-face enquiries, and supporting the smooth day-to-day running of the practice. The role also includes undertaking patient recalls to support QOF and other contractual targets, maintaining accurate patient records, and carrying out a range of administrative duties within a busy GP surgery environment. Job Summary The GP Receptionist & Administrator is responsible for providing a professional and efficient reception and administrative service to patients, clinicians and the wider practice team. The post holder will act as the first point of contact for patients, manage appointment requests, support patient access, undertake recall activities, maintain accurate patient records and contribute to the smooth day-to-day running of the practice. Main Duties and Responsibilities Reception and Patient Access Manage and maintain the practice appointment system. Process appointment requests received in person, by telephone and electronically. Answer incoming telephone calls promptly and professionally, dealing with enquiries appropriately. Welcome patients and visitors to the practice and provide assistance as required. Signpost patients to the most appropriate clinician, service or healthcare provider. Manage patient queries efficiently and sensitively, maintaining high standards of customer service. Ensure the reception and waiting areas remain clean, tidy and welcoming. Administration Initiate and respond to communications from patients, colleagues and external organisations. Register new and temporary patients and update patient demographic records. Input, code and maintain accurate information within the clinical system. Scan and process clinical and administrative documentation. Attach documents to patient records and action workflow tasks as required. Process incoming emails, correspondence and electronic communications. Undertake system searches and produce reports as requested. Recalls and Contractual Targets Support the delivery of Quality and Outcomes Framework (QOF), Enhanced Services and other contractual requirements. Undertake patient recalls, invitations and follow-up communications. Support the practice in maintaining accurate records to meet contractual and quality targets. Assist in monitoring appointment availability and utilisation to support patient access. Information Requests Direct requests for information, including Subject Access Requests (SARs), insurance reports, solicitor requests and DVLA forms, to the appropriate team member. Ensure all information is handled in accordance with practice policies and data protection requirements. General Responsibilities Support clinicians and colleagues with administrative tasks as required. Maintain patient information displays and notice boards. Participate in training, team meetings and practice development activities. Assist with opening and closing procedures in accordance with practice rotas. Provide reception and administrative cover during periods of annual leave, sickness absence and training. Support the processing of repeat prescription requests in accordance with practice procedures. Monitor stationery and office supplies as required. Undertake any other reasonable duties appropriate to the role and responsibilities of the post. Working Pattern and Flexibility The post holder must be flexible in their approach to working hours in order to meet the operational needs of the practice. Working hours and days may vary from time to time to provide cover for annual leave, sickness absence, training, and other staffing requirements. The successful candidate may be required to work shifts between 8:00am and 8:00pm, in line with the practice rota and service requirements. Occasional additional hours may be required to ensure adequate service provision and continuity of patient care. The post holder will be expected to support both reception and administrative functions as required and demonstrate flexibility in response to changing service demands. Confidentiality The post holder must maintain strict confidentiality at all times in relation to patient, staff and practice information and comply with all information governance requirements. Health and Safety The post holder will assist in promoting and maintaining a safe working environment for staff, patients and visitors, ensuring compliance with practice policies and procedures. Equality and Diversity The post holder will support the principles of equality, diversity and inclusion and treat all patients, colleagues and visitors with dignity and respect. Other This job description is intended as a guide to the principal responsibilities of the role and may be amended following consultation to meet the changing needs of the practice.
